meta.name: render-3d-product-showcase
meta.description: Assemble a premium 3D product-showcase ad from a config — four beat clips (an orbiting hero rotation, a macro push-in, a physics reveal, a typographic close) normalized to the brand-color canvas, hard-concatenated in order, closed on a deterministic Playwright brand end card, and mixed under one instrumental bed at loudnorm I=-16 (music-only, no VO). Ships the runnable build_endcard.py + build_masters.py; the rotation/macro clips are create-video-fal i2v seeded on a create-image-fal styled hero, the reveal is Veo3 i2v, and the bed is create-music-elevenlabs. Use for the 3d-product-showcase format.

copy.tagline: 从配置一键生成品牌3D产品展示广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作高质量3D产品展示视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a branded 3D product showcase ad video from a config.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-quality 3D product showcase video ads.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装一段 3D 产品展示广告视频：将四个片段（产品旋转、微距推进、物理特效、品牌结尾）拼接并添加背景音乐，输出最终视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户提供产品图片、品牌标志和文案，并请求制作 3D 产品展示广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我制作一个口红产品的 3D 展示广告。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供产品图片、品牌标志等素材。

say.text: 用这张产品图和品牌标志生成一段展示视频。
say.note: Claude 会按照配置流程生成四段片段并合成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically assemble a 3D product showcase ad from a config: concatenate four clips (hero rotation, macro push-in, physics reveal, typographic close) and mix with background music, outputting the final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a product image, brand logo, and copy, and requests a 3D product showcase ad.

say_en.text: Create a 3D showcase ad for this lipstick product.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product image, logo, etc.

say_en.text: Generate a showcase video using this product photo and brand logo.
say_en.note: Claude will produce four clips and assemble them.
